# axm_organizational_units (Data Source)

Fetches the list of organizational units from Apple Business Manager.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `organizational_units` (Attributes List) List of organizational units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizational_units))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--organizational_units"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizational_units`

Read-Only:

- `created_date_time` (String) The date and time the organizational unit was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the organizational unit.
- `id` (String) The organizational unit ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the organizational unit.
- `type` (String) The resource type.
- `updated_date_time` (String) The date and time the organizational unit was last modified.
